purpose: Read-only evidence for public forecast defaults and the CROP/ETH pool reference adapter.
read_method: Robinhood Chain public JSON-RPC only; eth_call and eth_getCode, no wallet provider, signing, simulation, swap or transaction.

season.interpretation: Pre-Genesis observation. Epoch 0 is the scheduled Genesis week, not a weather reading for the current civil week. Sunny is the live getter result at this block and can be changed before the weather cutoff; it is not an immutable forecast. Flood and Moon are not active in the read, and the weather contract reported no moon starts.

ordinary_weather_and_events.note: Events multiply ordinary weather independently before the 2x cap. The pinned read reports no currently active Flood or Moon; this does not establish the absence of future events.

address_source.note: The cached official client config publishes the pool address; it does not include the WETH address.

stored_slot0_price_interpretation.reason: The pool has zero active liquidity at this block. Its stored sqrtPriceX96 is not an executable quote or a live market-price reference.

seed_bag.label: Planting-parity scenario only; not a CROP market price, executable buy quote, or sell quote.
seed_bag.source_note: The live activation read supplies the bag price/open state at the pinned block. The Almanac describes daily repricing to 2,500 CROP in the pool; the reviewed source enforces no oracle or repricing schedule.

forecast_recommendation.crop_eth_quote_unavailable_reason: Published pool has zero active liquidity at block 61711122.
forecast_recommendation.fallback_scenario: The on-chain seed-bag price divided by the published 2,500 CROP plant cost is available as a clearly named planting-parity scenario only. It must not populate market-price or sell-quote evidence.
forecast_recommendation.weather: Use the chain-observed epoch-0 Sunny value only as a dated, replaceable Genesis-week observation. Future weather/events remain assumptions. Fair is a neutral fallback for unscheduled periods only when the UI labels it as an assumption; do not treat getter defaults as revealed weather.
forecast_recommendation.portfolio: Global minted count and total weight are both zero in this pre-mint observation; they do not establish visitor holdings. The public workspace remains empty until entered or observed wallet data/hypothetical plots are supplied.
forecast_recommendation.reserves: Pre-Genesis carry/Granary observation is 0 / 40M CROP. At later post-Genesis observation times, use refreshed values or label explicit reserve assumptions.

sources: knowledge/integrations.json (pool address and current getter signatures; source IDs client-config-2026-09-11 and forecast-pool-2026-09-13)
knowledge/contract-review.md, U11 / seed-bag review (daily pool repricing is an operational promise, not enforced by source)
https://rh.farm/almanac/ (current published plant, weather, seed-bag, and fee statements)
